change_log.value: Expose provider detail lookup via facade/tool API
Add unit and integration tests for provider detail service

FEAT-4-STORY-28.title: Define Provider Detail Response Schema
FEAT-4-STORY-28.description: Create a normalized provider detail schema (Pydantic or equivalent) that standardizes NPI Registry response fields including identifiers, taxonomy, addresses, and external links for downstream consumption.

FEAT-4-STORY-29.title: Expose Provider Detail Lookup via EvaluateCare Facade
FEAT-4-STORY-29.description: Integrate provider detail service into evaluate_care_facade and tool router, enabling agent-triggered lookup by NPI and returning structured provider details to the chat system.

FEAT-4-STORY-30.title: Implement Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Detail Lookup
FEAT-4-STORY-30.description: Develop tests validating NPI API parsing, schema normalization, external link generation, and facade/tool integration including error handling for missing or invalid NPIs.
